status: PRE-REGISTERED before any crackle-energy number, tile or AUC exists; no image, tile or CT pixel is viewed

control.surface_volume: PHercParis4/segments/20260623142658-w028-037/surface-volumes/1.129um-0.23m-78keV-volume-20260608103018-L1.zarr level 0 (2.258 um in-plane and depth; canvas identical to the M2b prediction canvas 49280 x 187760)
control.prediction_tiles: origin/claude/gifted-bell-gavnl5-sib-p4-tiles-b logs/sib/p4-tiles-b/m2b/tiles/*.png, bytes sha256-checked against m2b/manifest.json png_sha256, decoded as arrays only

tile_draw.pool: the 64 M2b tiles with valid_fraction >= 0.5 and frac_mesh_points_outside_1129_volume < 0.5 (DECL-P4-4-A1), sorted by (r, c)
tile_draw.rule: numpy.random.default_rng(20260926).choice(64, 16, replace=False); indices into the sorted pool; 16 >= 12 required

channel.slices: surface-volume slices 50..66 (centre 58 = n//2 of 116; |k| <= 8, i.e. |k| x 2.258 um <= 18.1 um <= 20 um)
channel.dog: per slice, float32 cv2.GaussianBlur sigma 1.5 px minus sigma 6.0 px (ksize 2*ceil(4 sigma)+1, BORDER_REFLECT at the halo edge), squared; tile read with a 32 px halo so no tile-edge effect
channel.energy: mean of the squared DoG over the 17 slices, at L0 (T x T canvas px of the tile, T = 8869 for M2b, zero-padded past the canvas)
channel.display_grid: cv2.resize INTER_AREA T x T -> 1068 x 1068 (18.73 um px; the same resize and pixel grid as the M2b PNGs)
channel.pos_mask: a 1068 px is mesh-valid with CT > 0 iff every L0 canvas px under it is mesh-valid (grid vertex (i//10, j//10) valid) and has a 17-slice raw CT mean > 0 (INTER_AREA mean of the L0 mask >= 1 - 1e-6)
channel.stretch: DECL-P4-5-A1: builder.linear_window_ct over pos pixels of the 1068 energy map; non-pos written as 0
channel.missing_chunks: S3 404 chunks are zeros (CT = 0, hence not pos)
channel.io: HTTP Range reads of bytes [50*16384, 67*16384) of each uncompressed 116x128x128 chunk; one chunk verified equal to the same slices of a full GET

auc.values_primary: the stretched uint8 P4-H display values (1068 grid)
auc.values_secondary: the unstretched float energy at 1068 (per-tile AUC; pooled over per-tile ranks is not used)
auc.analysis_mask: pos_mask of the crackle tile AND the 1068 px is fully mesh-valid on the prediction grid (same rule)
auc.thresholds_primary: p90 and p50 (numpy.percentile, linear) of the M2b prediction PNG values over the pooled analysis-mask pixels of all 16 control tiles; ink = pred >= p90, background = pred <= p50
auc.boundary_exclusion: ink px kept only if its Euclidean distance (scipy distance_transform_edt, px = 20 mm / 1068 = 18.727 um) to the nearest non-ink px is > 50 um; background likewise to the nearest non-background px; px outside the analysis mask count as non-class (conservative)
auc.statistic: Mann-Whitney AUC with average ranks for ties = P(crackle(ink) > crackle(bg)) + 0.5 P(tie)
auc.pooled: all kept ink and background px of all tiles together
auc.rot90_sanity: the prediction tile and its valid mask rotated by numpy.rot90(k=1); thresholds recomputed the same way on the rotated maps; crackle tile unrotated
auc.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of the 16 tiles with replacement, numpy default_rng(20260927); pooled AUC recomputed; 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles (for both the AUC and the rot-90 AUC)

decision: PASS iff pooled AUC >= 0.70 AND 0.47 <= pooled rot-90 AUC <= 0.53 (point estimates, DECL-P4-9 item 2). Otherwise FAIL: P4-H stops and is reported. The CI is reported, not used as the bar.
